US Strikes Iran Amid Escalating Tensions, Market Impact Noted

The United States has launched fresh airstrikes targeting Iranian military sites, escalating tensions after President Trump declared a ceasefire "over." This action follows Iran's retaliatory actions and reports of frustration among hardline factions regarding a memorandum of understanding. The conflict's resurgence has impacted global markets, with Brent crude prices rising, and has led to discussions about potential prolonged military engagement.
